note: Adversarial verification result. All quantified legs corroborate at press/IR/vendor grade — I fetched the Allianz IR release ($35B FIA reinsured; Talcott ~$111B pro-forma liabilities+surplus) and the PRNewswire Talcott completion release (>$90B liabilities, >600k annuity holders, ~$25B TAO platform), and independently confirmed CalPERS >$1B (Bloomberg/Bloomberg Law/TheMiddleMarket), the ~$130B insurance-assets-advised figure (Sixth Street Insurance Solutions page), ~$75B 2024 firm-wide AUM (multiple, including Wikipedia/Fortune), and Illinois TRS as one of ~35 TAO Partners LPs (PitchBook). NO leg reaches 'filing_verified': Sixth Street's TAO/credit vehicles are private (Form ADV/Form D) and publish no LP-composition table or insurance/pension/sovereign split, so no primary SEC filing supports a segmented funding share. The three quantified, multi-sourced legs are kept as 'analyst_kept_flagged'; the two 'inferred' legs (sovereign WF, generic institutional residual) carry no source supporting any amount or share and are rejected as funding-share claims. insurance_funded_share_pct correctly left null — the direction (material insurance/annuity general-account credit money routed through the TAO platform, with downside reaching policyholders/annuitants) is strongly supported, but no source states a % of TAO credit AUM that is insurance-funded, so any number would be fabricated. The approx_amount_usd in the original extraction (130000000000) for the Allianz leg was a platform 'assets advised' magnitude, not the Allianz transaction size; I corrected it to the verified $35B reinsured. total_credit_aum_usd $75B is firm-wide (not pure credit) and is press-reported, not filing-grade. Round numbers ($75B, $35B, $130B, >$1B) are all firm/press-stated headline figures, not analyst guesses, so they pass the round-number skepticism check. Caveat from the source review: no Sixth Street primary filing quantifies any data-center / neocloud / digital-infrastructure credit sleeve; the named large AI/data-center private-credit anchors are Blackstone/Apollo/Blue Owl/PIMCO/BlackRock-Magnetar, not Sixth Street — treat TAO digital-infra exposure as unconfirmed (null), not inferred. Overall 'partially_source_backed': sources are real and corroborated but none is a primary filing segmenting the funding base; majority are not filing_verified, so 'source_backed' is not warranted.
